_comment: Shipped preset for local Whisper large-v3. SubtitleGenStage passes the upstream audio or video /view URL as option:source into media. Slot 0 of node 1 is SRT, read with graph_output_first. Model path is resolved by the node (env, models/whisper, models/stt, then the documented fallback). No download.
label: Local Whisper large-v3
description: Offline Whisper large-v3 speech-to-text. SubtitleGenStage feeds an upstream video or audio file; the node returns SRT. Weights are a local Hugging Face snapshot (COMFYTV_WHISPER_MODEL, models/whisper, models/stt, or /home/nodecloud/whisper-v3/models/whisper-large-v3). Language defaults to zh.

media.error: Speech-to-text needs an upstream audio or video.
